source.title: Blouse on a hanger (Clothing Rail and Wardrobe)
source.author: 3D Assets
source.metadataSource: 3DAssets.dev listing; AI used, contributor-reported model Claude Opus 5

inspection.observed: Front/back/oblique show an indigo blouse on a velvet hanger, with white cuffs and a straight white front strip; back is plain, body flares slightly at hem.
inspection.collar: Listing calls it an off-white collar; screenshot top is dominated by hanger/neck bridge and does not show a turned collar with separate leaves or a readable stand.
inspection.placketAndButtons: A white placket is visible, but the listing does not specify buttons; screenshots show one small light dot, not clear enough to verify button attachment.
inspection.cuffs: White cuff bands visible at sleeve ends.
inspection.openings: Display remains mounted on hanger; actual neck/sleeve shell opening edges cannot be verified from screenshots.
inspection.drape: Static 1,300-triangle geometry; listing explicitly says no cloth simulation and no runtime creasing. Silhouette reads rigid and low-detail.
inspection.reason: Not a verifiable button-down collar construction; button attachment/open shell are unclear; hanger display and static low-detail surface do not meet natural drape requirements.
